title: Your travel agent needs your passport—again
scenario: Your usual travel agent emails from the address you recognize and says the airline has changed its passenger-data rules. They attach a new portal link and ask you to upload passport scans for everyone on the booking by tonight.

answers.A: Use the link because the message came from the agent’s real address and they already know who is travelling.
answers.B: Call the agent on the number already saved in your contacts or open the agency portal yourself and verify whether new documents are actually required.
answers.C: Ask the agent to place the request inside the booking or established client portal before you upload anything.

explanation: A familiar mailbox can be compromised, and passport scans are valuable enough to justify an independent check before uploading them to a new destination.
proTip: Known sender, new document portal: verify the portal—not just the sender.
